hypothesis: Increasing the initial HMM prefilter candidate cap from 100 to 400 recovers homologous links missing upstream of graph construction and phylogenetic reconciliation, with a measurable accuracy/resource tradeoff.
selection_reason: Among six independently read-back fresh-search arms, cap400 recovered 4301 additional watched same-family links without losing control links at E=1e-4. It scored 7893538 candidates versus 2034503. Shortlist20000, reduced_k4, and exact_k3 lost more watched control links than they gained; shared_hit1 had smaller gains and displaced 748 control links. Watched-link counts are reference-conditioned diagnostics, not accuracy validation.

fixed_parameters.search_backend: CPU HMM and compiled prefilter; CUDA disabled

execution.initial_search: Fresh all-to-all search of every protein against every complete input proteome. No query subset, cached hits, reference-driven candidate selection, or historical tree reuse.
execution.source: Frozen committed revision, with all executed Python and native libraries fingerprinted before and after execution.
execution.host: Local Threadripper, shared-host confounding recorded; unrelated workloads untouched.
execution.control_gate: Require successful fresh control, validated complete gene universe, validated native pair outputs, recorded actual parameters, and independent scoring before interpreting the cap400 arm. Record exact native-product comparisons and metric differences against the historical baseline. If the historical control differs, retain both as distinct results; no historical-baseline or promotion claim until the discrepancy is explained or a matched contemporary control is reproduced.
execution.failures: Retain failed and skipped cases; any retry requires a new namespace after authoritative terminal-state confirmation. Never silently overwrite products or substitute missing scores.

evaluation.selection: Require a complete eight-endpoint vector, improvement in at least one primary endpoint, and no observed decline exceeding 0.005 against the matched control. Report Pareto tradeoffs and all deltas. This is development point-estimate screening, not statistical equivalence. Promotion also requires reproducibility and an explicitly justified computational cost.
evaluation.comparators: Retained OrthoHMM high-sensitivity and phylogenetic baselines, OrthoFinder 3.1.5 full pipeline and sequence-only checkpoint diagnostic, SonicParanoid, Proteinortho, FastOMA, and OrthoMCL 1.4. Preserve each output's benchmark semantics.
evaluation.limits: All current datasets are development-exposed. TreeFam is supporting evidence. FAS sampling is unseeded. Functional similarity is not proof of orthology correctness; Three Kingdoms assesses narrow BUSCO-reference co-membership. Shared-host runtime is descriptive, not an isolated speed ranking.

defaults: Keep production defaults unchanged throughout this round.
next_round: Diagnose complete-pipeline error changes before testing interactions with broader candidates or additional search changes; do not force unpromising diagnostic arms into expensive trials.
git: Commit and push this plan before executing benchmark variants; commit tested implementation and independently validated result milestones.
